FAQ_CONFIG.question: What is Treasure Chess?
FAQ_CONFIG.answer: Treasure Chess is an app that lets you save, collect, trade, and marvel at unique games of chess by saving them as NFTs. Each token represents a completely unique game, no two can represent the same sequence of moves, and its other attributes are a reflection of those particular moves.
